title: Receipt eval label
description: Ground-truth extraction for one receipt. Mirrors the public ParsedReceipt shape (store_name + items) so predictions and labels compare field-for-field.

case_id.description: Must match the manifest entry id and the case folder name.

store_name.description: Canonical store name as a human would write it, or null if not printed.

items.description: Every printed line item, food and non-food. Summary lines (SUBTOTAL, TAX, TOTAL, payment) are NOT items.

store_item_name.description: Text exactly as printed (minus item codes/UPCs).

ingredient_name.description: Plain-English grocery name with abbreviations expanded.

quantity.description: Quantity as printed ("2.14", "12"). null when the receipt shows none.

unit.description: One of app.validation.INGREDIENT_UNITS, or null when not printed/inferable.

totals.description: Optional printed totals; used to sanity-check the parser's totals gate.
